resolved.text: Following our guidance, you turned on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it, and the email from your test form submission arrived.

covered.text: We explained that the email can sometimes land in spam, so verifying your sender domain is a good idea, and that you can do this in the email domain section of your settings.

customer_next_steps.text: Verify your sender domain in the email domain section of your settings.

call_purpose: You wanted the autoresponder email to reach the leads coming in from your form, who were arriving but not receiving it.
